title: Comparative-cosmos tradition context ledger
method: Repository-only reading at the recorded baseline; no network fetch and no external source. Every statement is authored prose, not a reproduced translation.
rights_note: Locator quotes are short repository fragments (<= 120 characters). No scripture translation is reproduced beyond the already verified QS 2:82 selector metadata, and no Arabic text is copied into this ledger.

rows.statement: The corpus indexes one Qur'anic address, QS 2:82, as a passage row; this ledger keeps it as scripture narrative, not as evidence about the sky.
The passage row records a verification instant from the M07-05 selector; verification of an address is not an astronomical result.
A named Indonesian translation is attached with its own rights status, so wording, translator identity and permission remain separate fields.
Only an exact cleared Cairo edition may serialize text; the rights field gates reproduction, not a cosmological inference.
The corpus addon registers no tafsir or commentary model, so exegesis is reported as unavailable rather than reconstructed.

locator.quote: no commentary/interpretation model is registered in the corpus addon

rows.statement: No licensed tafsir text for QS 2:82 is present; a commentary row would need an edition record, translator identity, rights status and a reviewed passage locator.
rows.missing: A licensed tafsir edition record (publisher, edition year, translator, rights status) plus a reviewed commentary passage locator for QS 2:82; the vision lists quran-tafsir-sample only as a source name requiring separate edition and rights review.

rows.statement: No ancient Near Eastern creation, flood or sky text is ingested; the repository holds no edition, passage, excerpt or translation for this tradition.
A Torah edition is inventoried with provenance and a cleared licence, but no Torah passage is seeded in the corpus.
A Psalms edition is inventoried as a historical codex witness; no Psalm text or passage row exists in the corpus.
Gospel codex witnesses are inventoried; the corpus contains no Gospel passage, so no comparison text is available.
The header phase value is arithmetic from a fixed mean synodic month and epoch, not a pinned ephemeris; an audit records it as an approximation.
No pinned almanac, ephemeris library or astronomy store is present, so no sky position or phase can be quoted as an astronomy reference.
rows.missing: A pinned almanac or ephemeris library with publisher, edition, digest, time scale and licence or permission, as the M25-05 sketch requires and M25-03 H5 records as BLOCKED-SOURCE.

rows.statement: No instrument, calibration record or UTC observation accompanies any comparative-cosmos item; no physical reading exists to report.
No named cosmological model with declared inputs and a non-measurement notice exists; simulation output is not available for comparison.

The vision requires astronomical observation, simulation, historical hypothesis, philosophical interpretation, scripture claim, speculative technology and RPG representation to stay in separate categories.

locator.quote: astronomical observation, numerical simulation, historical hypothesis

rows.statement: The vision states that Qur'anic creation references do not prove an arithmetic code or a scientific timescale; scripture cannot supply a cosmological constant.

locator.quote: Doesn't prove a secret arithmetic code, nor arbitrary scientific timescales

rows.statement: Canon and sacredness are tradition-scoped assertions, so the ledger may not convert one tradition's canon into a shared verdict.

locator.quote: Canon status and sacredness are tradition-scoped assertions

rows.statement: The four universe lenses are editorial groupings, not verified cosmological realms, and carry no observational status.

locator.quote: | **4 universe lenses** | Editorial groupings | Verified cosmological realms |

rows.statement: No comparative-cosmos source set with per-edition rights exists; cross-tradition comparison needs reviewed editions before any row can be shown.
rows.missing: A comparative-cosmos source set with per-edition rights, translation identity and review status; the M25-05 sketch records that no comparative-cosmos source set exists (docs/design/M25-05-cosmos-time-explorer-sketch.md:115).
